name: MTP speculative-decoding sweep — n-max x p-min on a code probe (Ornith-1.5-9B)

what_changed: model: Q4_K_M of Ornith-1.5-9B-MTP, not Qwen3.8-27B. Nothing here reproduces a reference-campaign number and no arm may be quoted against results/ARM-PROVENANCE.md's grades.

the draft head is a SEPARATE sibling GGUF (-md drafter). The reference model carried its MTP layer in-file; on this model llama.cpp b10717 ignores the in-file blk.32 entirely (15 'unused tensor ... ignoring' warnings), so the head is the only speculation source that works.

-c 32768, not 122880: sized to match this campaign's Stage-1 floors so the sweep and the floors are one comparison (rule 30 — compare arms inside one sweep). The whole 262,144 window fits, so this is a cost choice, not a ceiling.
KV left at the server default f16, not -ctk/-ctv q8_0, for the same reason: the Stage-1 floors were taken at f16 and a cache-type change is a condition change (rule 3).

--chat-template-kwargs {"enable_thinking":false}: this model's effort knob is BOOLEAN (enable_thinking), not the reference's graded reasoning_effort. Thinking is held OFF across the sweep so the arms differ only in speculation.

the reference's --load-mode/--reasoning-preserve/--image-min-tokens and its sampler block are dropped: they are the reference server's conditions, not this one's, and the probe pins temperature 0 / top_k 1 anyway.

notes: Rule 11: acceptance IS the speculative speedup, but MEAN DRAFT LENGTH is the throughput predictor — the ledger must carry both for every arm, and the report publishes both.

Arm 1 (spec-none) is the in-sweep baseline. The Stage-1 floor for Q4_K_M was 118.38 t/s at these same conditions; if spec-none lands far from that, the sweep is measuring something other than speculation and stops.

Fresh server per arm. One temp-0 probe each, 700 tokens, the same red-black-tree code prompt across every arm — novel code is the regime where MTP acceptance is hardest, which is why the reference chose it.
Desktop is LIVE for every arm (GNOME + Steam + browser). Rule 27: that costs decode invisibly and equally across arms; it is a condition of the sweep, not a difference between its arms.

record.mean_draft_length: server log 'mean len', or draft_n / (predicted_n - draft_n_accepted)
